interpretationsA.howIRead: Support lists ENTAILS items and met NARROWS items, marked '(narrows)'. ASSUMED bounds and inert items are not listed; 'none' otherwise.

interpretationsB.rule: RC-36 / Â§3 'The session supports E1â€“E4 only'

interpretationsB.howIRead: SD-11 yields only to a support-capable item that gives a contrary value. EXISTS gives none, and the ASSUMED items agree. Its condition, the longer dimension, rests on E2 and E3, both ENTAILED, so SD-11 entails S1.

interpretationsB.rule: Â§2 NOT_AUTHORED vs INVENTED; Â§4 bar; RC-18
interpretationsB.point: An unsupported value where an UNDECLARED or NOT_AUTHORED declaration reaches the element, but the row is not fillable or the element's existence is not entailed
interpretationsB.howIRead: The verdict is NOT_AUTHORED (COVERAGE for UNDECLARED, DECLARED_GAP for NOT_AUTHORED) wherever no item authors the value, not only where a free choice was otherwise open. This parallels the ASSUMED rule's 'NOT_AUTHORED(ASSUMED_ONLY) where a declaration reaches it'. Examples: L8, L13, L24, L44, L54, L58.

interpretationsB.point: P6a and P6b: the game's value differs from the value an in-scope ENTAILS item fixes, and the same contract also declares NOT_AUTHORED on a sub-question
interpretationsB.howIRead: The row is authored for the element, so NOT_AUTHORED does not apply. The game's departing value is INVENTED (L46, L47), and the entailing items are VIOLATED forward.

interpretationsB.rule: RC-1 reach / Â§4 condition 4 / COVERAGE ('a contract never declared the row')
interpretationsB.point: A contract that declares the row but whose selectors do not reach the element (RPC-001 S5/S6 select only objective-area zones; WIDEZONE's noun lists omit 'area'; A01-02 O4/O5 cover ball, goal, line, gate)
interpretationsB.howIRead: Such a contract neither bars nor permits, and it is not COVERAGE because it did declare the row. COVERAGE comes only from an UNDECLARED declaration that reaches the element. Every contract declares every area-1 row.

interpretationsB.point: L36: an UNSTATED value (corridor S5) that no NOT_AUTHORED or UNDECLARED declaration reaches
interpretationsB.howIRead: INVENTED needs a present value, so the line is NOT_AUTHORED. I used COVERAGE, citing RPC-001's S5 declarations, which do not reach the corridor. This is the only line decided on that ground.

interpretationsB.point: More than one code applies
interpretationsB.howIRead: DECLARED_GAP first. Next, an evidence code (ENGINE_ONLY) where engine-only items are the only matching evidence (L49â€“L51, where COVERAGE also applies). COVERAGE otherwise.

interpretationsB.rule: RC-1: selectors tested on stated attributes
interpretationsB.point: The game's kind 'target zone (off-list)' against GF2 selectors kind âˆˆ {line, zone}
interpretationsB.howIRead: Literal match: 'target zone' is not 'zone'. GF2-06.a/06.b and GF2's O-row declarations on {line, zone} therefore do not reach the tz objects, and GF2-06.a/06.b are UNMET forward. A semantic match would make them SATISFIED and turn the tz O2 reason into DECLARED_GAP.

interpretationsB.point: P3 selectors team=ATTACKING_TEAM and team=BUILD_OUT_TEAM against the stated TEAM_A / TEAM_B
interpretationsB.howIRead: Evaluated through the designation map at each episode. Each team is ATTACKING_TEAM, and BUILD_OUT_TEAM, in some episode, so both satisfy the selectors. I used RC-22 equality only when comparing designation values (P6b).

interpretationsB.point: Units set-A and set-B, whose J5 existence is judged in area 2 and is not visible in this input
interpretationsB.howIRead: I assumed both units' existence is entailed, so VARTARGET-01.a/02.a entail the four tz objects. If area 2 finds a set not entailed, that set's tz O1 lines become INVENTED.

interpretationsB.rule: RC-17 (existence and value judged separately) / RC-2

interpretationsB.howIRead: An EXISTS, or a RANGE minimum on O1, entails existence, not an element's O3 value. The ball's O3 is not fillable (no COUNT/RANGE). The tz O3 is fillable inside VARTARGET-01.a but barred by UNDECLARED declarations, so both are NOT_AUTHORED(COVERAGE).

interpretationsB.howIRead: An item or declaration with OWN_INVOLVEMENT reaches only the elements its contract entails: channel-north and channel-south, entailed by 02.a/03. It does not reach area, the halves or the corridor.

interpretationsB.rule: Â§2 verdicts for an absence line
interpretationsB.point: L44: target-players NONE
interpretationsB.howIRead: An absence is not 'present', so it is not INVENTED. Nothing entails it and P4 is not fillable. UNDECLARED P4 [*] (RPC-001, Neutral) reaches literally, although their notes say 'other roles', so the verdict is NOT_AUTHORED(COVERAGE).

interpretationsB.point: 'regions without the trigger function', 'candidate objects', 'non-candidate objects'
interpretationsB.howIRead: Applied as worded. An element with unstated functions counts as lacking the trigger function. The tz objects are candidates, since they are in a set's unit through J7/J2; the ball is not.

interpretationsB.point: A REQUIRED COLLECTION RANGE min 1 with no matching element (GF2-03.a, GF2-06.a)
interpretationsB.howIRead: UNMET, following 'a REQUIRED item matching no element', rather than VIOLATED.

interpretationsB.point: A SUPPORTING PREFERRED_DEFAULT FIELD item that matches no element (GF2-05.b)
interpretationsB.howIRead: SATISFIED (met, with nothing to check), not ADAPTED.

interpretationsB.point: Items with ENGINE_ONLY basis that are also PARTLY_STRUCTURAL or OUTSIDE_BOUNDARY (RPC-001-04.c, 05.a, 09.a, 09.b)
interpretationsB.howIRead: INERT: the basis governs, so neither CLAUSE_CHECKED nor NOT_CHECKABLE.

interpretationsB.point: VARTARGET-05.a, a PREFERRED_DEFAULT trigger region the game lacks
interpretationsB.howIRead: ADAPTED: the game departs from the default. The item is SUPPORTING, so it is not UNMET.

interpretationsB.point: ASSUMED items (RPC-001-01.a, 02, GF2-14.b, NEUTRAL-09.a, 10.a, WIDEZONE-01.b, 07, 10.a/b, A01-02-09.a)
interpretationsB.howIRead: Checked as bounds: SATISFIED when the game meets them.

interpretationsB.point: NEUTRAL-06.b, REQUIRED PREFERRED_DEFAULT EQUALS contrasting bibs
interpretationsB.howIRead: The game uses its value, so it supports as EQUALS: ENTAILED (L48).

interpretationsB.point: P6b: WON_BALL against ATTACKING_TEAM and DEFENDING_TEAM
interpretationsB.howIRead: Different entries. Not equal to ATTACKING_TEAM, so 03.a and 14.b are VIOLATED; not equal to DEFENDING_TEAM, so the 04.a exclusion is SATISFIED.

interpretationsB.point: A bound read from other rows (P2 of the other team, P5)
interpretationsB.howIRead: Evaluated with the game's values (4 > 4-2) and treated as an authored RANGE for P2 fillability. This is moot, because GF2's NOT_AUTHORED bars P2.

interpretationsB.point: Own-half regions on S2 when RPC-001-06 (own half, need not be marked) sits on SV1
interpretationsB.howIRead: A view supports no stored row, and 06 is ENGINE_ONLY. No S2 item matches noun half, so the half regions and their stated fields are INVENTED, except S4, which is COVERAGE.

interpretationsB.point: Selectors in the input appear as mojibake (e.g. 'Ã¢Ë†â€¹', 'Ã¢Ë†Ë†')
interpretationsB.howIRead: Read as âˆ‹ and âˆˆ respectively.

interpretationsB.point: A01-02 selector restart=GOAL_KICK (not a T1 selectorAttribute)
interpretationsB.howIRead: No game T1 element states a 'restart' attribute; the 'goal kick' wording in slot notes or T5 values is not one. It matches nothing: REQUIRED FIELD items are UNMET, declarations with it reach nothing, and 'elements other than the goal kick' reaches every element.

interpretationsB.point: Selector team=BUILD_OUT_TEAM (RPC-001-11.a, 08.c) and team=DEFENDING_TEAM (RPC-001 J1 NOT_AUTHORED) against stated TEAM_A/TEAM_B
interpretationsB.howIRead: I evaluated them through the designation map at the one build-out episode whose existence is entailed (START, per KR-03): BUILD_OUT_TEAM=Team A, DEFENDING_TEAM=Team B. So 11.a/08.c match tz-A-*, and RPC-001's NOT_AUTHORED reaches tz-B-*.

interpretationsB.point: Whether 11.a entails J3=TEAM_A
interpretationsB.howIRead: 11.a's selector fixes team=BUILD_OUT_TEAM, which equals TEAM_A at START, so the J3 value of the element 11.a entails is ENTAILED.

interpretationsB.point: Which of several identical-attribute elements an EXISTS/RANGE minimum entails
interpretationsB.howIRead: The minimum is allocated to the first N matching elements in game order: 11.a/08.a to obj:tz-A-north; 06.a to set-A; GF2-09.a to obj:tz-B-north. The rest are count fill.

interpretationsB.point: Whether an objective is in its own set's unit (VARTARGET-06.b, L-01)
interpretationsB.howIRead: Objectives listed as J7 members count as in their set's unit. The J2 clause adds only the elements they reference.

interpretationsB.point: PER_TEAM units: team-A/team-B existence is in area 1 and not visible here
interpretationsB.howIRead: I assumed both team units' existence is entailed. Set-B's unit is not entailed (06.a gives one set), so 06.b entails nothing there.

interpretationsB.point: VARTARGET scope
interpretationsB.howIRead: OWN_INVOLVEMENT = set-A and obj:tz-A-* (what VARTARGET entails). Its OWN_INVOLVEMENT items and declarations do not reach set-B or tz-B-*. Its NON_CLAIMED team=TEAM_<opposing team> is read as Team B.

interpretationsB.rule: RC-17 NOT_AUTHORED vs INVENTED; reason priority
interpretationsB.point: A present value with no ENTAILS on a non-fillable row
interpretationsB.howIRead: NOT_AUTHORED, not INVENTED, whenever a declaration reaches it or engine/assumed evidence exists. Reason priority: RC-9/SD-R3/PSD-03 (T2-T6) > DECLARED_GAP > ALTERNATIVES > ASSUMED_ONLY/ENGINE_ONLY (only if the item bears on the value, not mere presence) > COVERAGE.

interpretationsB.point: RPC-001-15.a and NEUTRAL-13.a (EXISTS field presence) on START T2
interpretationsB.howIRead: They are not NARROWS items, but they do not constrain the value, which meets them. I did not treat them as barring, so L114 is NARROWED_CHOICE under the SD-R2 fillable entry.

interpretationsB.rule: Â§3 EXISTS on a FIELD row
interpretationsB.point: VARTARGET-06.e 'members lists the candidate objectives'
interpretationsB.howIRead: This is presence only, never member identity, so the J7 member lines have no ENTAILS source.

interpretationsB.rule: VIEW rows vs RC-17 (N/A only via RC-20)
interpretationsB.point: DV1 lines L111/L112
interpretationsB.howIRead: A view needs no support and ORIENTED only narrows, but N/A is barred. I gave NOT_AUTHORED(DECLARED_GAP): it is computed from J3 values that RPC-001/GF2 declare NOT_AUTHORED, and GF2's DV1 NOT_AUTHORED reaches it.

interpretationsB.point: Game value 'team defending that end (= NOT_LAST_TOUCH)'
interpretationsB.howIRead: I took the game's stated equality at face value, so GF2-16.a's value is used and ENTAILS. I did not test the off-list 'team defending that end' separately, although T1b is unstated.

interpretationsB.point: The game splits OUT_END_LINE into two last-touch elements
interpretationsB.howIRead: Construction covers each reachable last-touch case, so both existence lines are ENTAILED. The qualifier values are judged on T1a (COVERAGE).

interpretationsB.point: START T7 is UNSTATED in the game
interpretationsB.howIRead: SD-14 entails T7=true at START, so the line is ENTAILED (the value is authored by a standing decision); the note flags the omission.

interpretationsB.point: tr-PC T6 STOP_RESUME
interpretationsB.howIRead: No support-capable T6 or V11 selection item creating a stoppage is visible in this input; the game's cons-reset is a game element, not an item. SD-20 does not yield, and GF2-17 is ADAPTED. The only evidence is RPC-001-16.c, so NOT_AUTHORED(ENGINE_ONLY), not INVENTED.

interpretationsB.point: T2-T5 of tr-PC
interpretationsB.howIRead: RC-20 is keyed to the game's stated playState (STOP_RESUME), so those lines are judged, not N/A, even though SD-20 would give CONTINUE.

interpretationsB.point: VARTARGET-08.a requires an entry keyed on one of four triggers; the game has none
interpretationsB.howIRead: The needed element's key is a set of alternatives on a non-fillable row, so NOT_AUTHORED(ALTERNATIVES) for set-A; COVERAGE for set-B, which is outside VARTARGET's scope.

interpretationsB.point: 'The objective-area region of GF2-03.a' vs the game's J2 object references
interpretationsB.howIRead: Not equal: the game references O1 target-zone objects, and no game region states the objective-area function. The forward result is VIOLATED; it is no collision, because no other item gives a J2 value.

interpretationsB.point: Items that are both ENGINE_ONLY and PREFERRED_DEFAULT or PARTLY_STRUCTURAL (A01-02-06.a, 03.a)
interpretationsB.howIRead: Inertness wins: INERT, not ADAPTED or CLAUSE_CHECKED. For a REQUIRED FIELD item with no matching element, UNMET even though RC-1 counts it met.

interpretationsB.point: Off-list scope BUILD_OUT_EPISODE; PARTLY_STRUCTURAL; no J11b elements
interpretationsB.howIRead: CLAUSE_CHECKED, with the clause UNMET (no assignment keys, so no yields).

interpretationsB.point: A01-02 J1 NOT_AUTHORED with an unwritable selector (L6); VARTARGET J10 NOT_AUTHORED on members âˆˆ {START,...}
interpretationsB.howIRead: Neither reaches any element: the first has no testable predicate, and the game's J10 names no triggers.

interpretationsB.point: L160: V1 is fillable and RC-29 says the chosen member is NARROWED_CHOICE, but GF2 declares V1 NOT_AUTHORED (selector *).
interpretationsB.howIRead: The NOT_AUTHORED declaration bars free choice even on a fillable row, so I gave NOT_AUTHORED(DECLARED_GAP). RR-01 and RPC-001-RR-1 decide collisions only, and there is none here.

interpretationsB.point: Several lines fit more than one reason code, for example ENGINE_ONLY plus DECLARED_GAP, or ALTERNATIVES plus DECLARED_GAP.
interpretationsB.howIRead: Where an item on the line's own row is the only evidence, I named its kind: ENGINE_ONLY, OUTSIDE_BOUNDARY, ASSUMED_ONLY or ALTERNATIVES. Otherwise DECLARED_GAP if a NOT_AUTHORED declaration reaches, else COVERAGE if only UNDECLARED does.

interpretationsB.point: An unsupported value present on a non-fillable row (L166, L173, L177-L178, L181, L189-L192, L194-L197).
interpretationsB.howIRead: NOT_AUTHORED where a NOT_AUTHORED or UNDECLARED declaration reaches the element (mirroring the ASSUMED rule's 'where a declaration reaches it'), otherwise INVENTED.

interpretationsB.point: WIDEZONE's V11 NOT_AUTHORED (selector *) concerns its own advantage, yet by selector it reaches cons-neutral and cons-reset.
interpretationsB.howIRead: I applied the selector, not the note, so L189 and L194 are DECLARED_GAP. Their V12-V14a fields, which no such declaration reaches, are INVENTED.

interpretationsB.point: VARTARGET-11.a's clause reads 'a primary event exists and its derived reference includes the set's members'.
interpretationsB.howIRead: The clause is structural, so the item entails pe's existence (L159). SD-06 is cited alongside as a typed citable item.

interpretationsB.point: V4 type lines have no items on V4.
interpretationsB.howIRead: The V3 EXISTS items whose selectors fix type= (18.a, 18.c, 18.f, 19.a) entail the V4 value. Eligibility gets no carry, because its existence is not entailed.

interpretationsB.point: RPC-001-18.b is a 2-member set, and the game uses both members as separate referents (L164, L165).
interpretationsB.howIRead: I judged each referent line as a chosen member of the alternatives on a non-fillable row, giving NOT_AUTHORED(ALTERNATIVES). I counted own-half as the member 'controlled defensive restart placement', so the bound is met.

interpretationsB.point: The game's progression referent is the defenders' start line, which 18.d puts in its outside part.
interpretationsB.howIRead: Line L169 is NOT_AUTHORED(OUTSIDE_BOUNDARY). For the forward result I report CLAUSE_CHECKED with the clause unmet, because the referent is not a marked line or the PRIMARY_SCORING reference.

interpretationsB.point: L182: the game says 'long kick', while RPC-001-19.b authors 'a long clearance that happens to reach the target'.
interpretationsB.howIRead: The line is 'long kick', so FREE(b). No collision, since only one support-capable item applies. For the forward result 19.b is VIOLATED, because the term is not verbatim.

interpretationsB.point: info-live's stated subject says 'active candidate', while VARTARGET-13.a's selector says 'live member of this object's candidate set'.
interpretationsB.howIRead: I treated them as the same subject, so the selector is satisfied (L198, L199).

interpretationsB.howIRead: Only elements VARTARGET entails (info-live) are in scope. info-wide is out of scope, so there is no collision or breach against WIDEZONE-17.b's STANDING at L208.

interpretationsB.point: L204: V21 is unstated in the game, but VARTARGET-13.d authors OBJECTIVE_DEPENDENT.
interpretationsB.howIRead: The verdict is RESOLVED:ENTAILED because the property is authored. The omission goes in the forward list as UNMET, not in the verdict.

interpretationsB.point: Items that match an element whose field is absent (VARTARGET-13.d, VARTARGET-05.b).
interpretationsB.howIRead: By analogy with RC-1's 'met, nothing to check': a REQUIRED item gets UNMET, and a SUPPORTING bound gets SATISFIED (vacuous).

interpretationsB.point: 'NOT_AUTHORED(ASSUMED_ONLY) where a declaration reaches it' (L206-L209).
interpretationsB.howIRead: I counted the owning contract's CLAIMED declaration (WIDEZONE on the wide-channel subject) as reaching, giving ASSUMED_ONLY rather than INVENTED.

interpretationsB.point: L210 is a placeholder for zero time windows. No verdict fits, and N/A is limited to RC-20.
interpretationsB.howIRead: RESOLVED:ENTAILED by construction: no item entails any element (RC-2), so zero is the entailed state, and all six contracts are NON_CLAIMED. Support is recorded as none.

interpretationsB.point: L193 (V14c, unstated): no item, and every reaching declaration is NON_CLAIMED, so no reason code fits.
interpretationsB.howIRead: NOT_AUTHORED(COVERAGE) as the nearest code, noted as an imperfect fit.

interpretationsB.point: L183: WIDEZONE's advantage has three alternatives (bonus point, free restart, multiplier), but those items are TYPICAL_EXAMPLE.
interpretationsB.howIRead: Inert items form no alternatives set, so DECLARED_GAP (WIDEZONE's V7 NOT_AUTHORED) rather than ALTERNATIVES.

interpretationsB.point: L175: the live-only eligibility rests on VARTARGET-12.b, an OUTSIDE_BOUNDARY item on V0.
interpretationsB.howIRead: Only items on V3 reach this line, so I gave DECLARED_GAP (NEUTRAL's eligibility NOT_AUTHORED) rather than OUTSIDE_BOUNDARY.

interpretationsB.point: The game restates the whole authored range (STATE_TRANSITION | OPPONENT_ACTION; IMMEDIATE | STAGED) instead of choosing a member.
interpretationsB.howIRead: Bound met, but a set never entails and the row is not fillable, so NOT_AUTHORED(ALTERNATIVES). I preferred this over VARTARGET's V18 DECLARED_GAP.

interpretationsB.point: L185 and L186: mod-wide's existence is NOT_AUTHORED, but WIDEZONE-11.a entails its referents.
interpretationsB.howIRead: Fields may be ENTAILED despite unentailed existence, so both lines are RESOLVED:ENTAILED.

interpretationsB.howIRead: The basis governs, so all three are INERT, not SATISFIED or ADAPTED.

interpretationsB.point: WIDEZONE-11.b and 14.a (selector effect=RESTART) match no V11 element. 14.a is ASSUMED.
interpretationsB.howIRead: Both are UNMET. ASSUMED basis does not change the forward result.

interpretationsB.point: The game's V22 'both teams' against WIDEZONE-17.c's ALL.
interpretationsB.howIRead: I read them as equal, so the bound is met and 17.c is SATISFIED.
